chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Said from Ibn Abi Umayr and Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
When the wife of a slave woman dies, her waiting period (iddah) is two months and five days.
ai.seo_question: What is the waiting period for a slave woman after her husband dies?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar specifies the iddah for a slave woman (ama) as two months and five days, a ruling derived from the general Quranic verse for free women but adjusted for her status. In Shia jurisprudence, this distinction highlights the legal nuance where the slave's waiting period is not a full four months and ten days, reflecting the specific conditions of her marital bond and ownership.
